repo.description:
### Impact

The calendar app allowed blindly booking appointments with a squential ID without known the appointment token.

### Patches

It is recommended that Nextcloud Calendar is upgraded to 4.7.19, 5.5.6 or 6.0.1.

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3275810)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/calendar/pull/7537)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Calendar app allowed booking appointments without the generated token
